name: jev-shadow
description: Logs TypeSafe Jev's typed hazard verdicts next to auto mode's classifier denials, at zero latency. Can gate tool calls for sessions without a classifier.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: Key for the backend named in ~/.config/jev-shadow/config.json (TypeSafe, Vercel AI Gateway, or OpenRouter). Leave empty with the mock backend.
